source_operator_decision_text: Operator decision: do not re-run the expensive `2023_5.zip` package validation. The package has already completed and was previously validated on the target host; repeating validation of this very large package would add cost without new evidence. Treat `2023_5.zip` completion as accepted operator evidence. Any remaining work should be separated into lightweight, resource-safe full-corpus checkpoint / runtime-gate engineering and must not require reprocessing or rescanning the package itself.
statement: This record preserves the operator's explicit acceptance of prior target-host validation. It does not claim that a fresh full-corpus semantic checkpoint was executed. Current serving-state evidence is still required before M1.7 release promotion.
